problem: crowdsourced dynamic VRP
finding: Title only: proposes a crowdsourced adaptive vehicle routing framework for last-mile delivery under dynamic traffic.

problem: two-echelon EVRP with time windows and delivery robots
finding: Using robots for final deliveries reduces overall time costs; ALNS yields high-quality solutions for large instances.

problem: drone delivery winner determination (combinatorial double auction)
finding: MOEAs find feasible Pareto solutions far faster than repeated MILP for the drone delivery auction problem.

problem: parcel locker allocation and modular locker configuration
method: MIP + SPEA2 and contour line heuristic
finding: Jointly optimising parcel allocation and modular locker configuration reduces operational cost and customer walking distance.

problem: review
finding: Optimisation for megalopolitan last-mile logistics has moved to AI-driven dynamic routing and MILP for hybrid assets, with crowdsourcing integration improving cost and success rates but facing scalability and equity gaps.

problem: multicommodity pickup and delivery with time windows and handling time
method: MIP + tabu thresholding and memetic algorithm
finding: Proposed heuristics efficiently solve omni-channel last-mile pickup-and-delivery for a 3PL provider.

problem: multi-trip VRP with sustainability objectives
finding: Model incorporating economic, environmental and social criteria improved overall sustainability impact by 43% in a case study.

problem: truck-drone coalition routing
method: MILP + NSGA-II with Bayesian trust updating
finding: Trust-based coalition framework yields fewer disruptions, 94% on-time delivery and 9% lower cost versus static trust models.

problem: VRP with stochastic shared delivery terminal capacity
finding: Forecasting terminal capacity from usage data and optimising routes improves delivery performance under capacity uncertainty.

problem: mixed-fleet VRP
finding: Title only: proposes a novel mathematical model for mixed-fleet vehicle routing in smart-city last-mile delivery.

problem: dynamic traffic-aware VRP
finding: T-ALNS-RRD cuts operational cost by 24.3% and raises on-time delivery from 68.1% to 92.8% in an urban scenario.

problem: off-peak delivery policy / time-slot allocation
finding: An off-peak hours delivery policy is modelled as a bi-objective MIP to balance retailer economics with environmental and social impacts.

problem: drone delivery network design with recharging stations under uncertainty
finding: Scenario-wise GA outperforms commercial solvers by up to 55%, and system hardening substantially improves network reliability.

problem: dynamic VRP with predictive analytics
finding: Integrating ML predictions of traffic and customer behaviour with VRP enables dynamic route adjustment for e-commerce last-mile delivery.

problem: e-cargo bike VRP
finding: An MILP solved with an evolutionary algorithm improves e-cargo bike parcel routing efficiency and lowers cost and emissions.

problem: multi-depot CVRPTW with drones/ADVs and micro-hub location
finding: Branch-and-price with valid inequalities efficiently solves joint micro-hub location and multi-modal routing.

problem: multi-vehicle drone collaborative routing
finding: HSMOA balances operational cost and workload fairness in large-scale vehicle-drone routing better than existing methods.

problem: two-echelon VRP with customer-to-parcel locations and synchronisation
finding: Title only: studies a grey-zone two-echelon VRP with synchronisation and parcel locations for last-mile deliveries.

problem: truck-UAV routing and scheduling
finding: MILP-guided initialisation accelerates convergence and improves Pareto diversity for multi-objective truck-UAV delivery.

problem: CVRP comparison of delivery modes (robots, bikes, vans)
finding: Delivery robots are efficient in pedestrian, traffic-limited areas while cargo bikes are better in dense city centres.

problem: VRP with drones and mobile base stations under airspace constraints
finding: Airspace compliance adds 4-5 h delay and up to 15% cost, mitigated by mobile base stations.

problem: smart locker location
method: BWM-fuzzy MARCOS + stochastic multi-objective MIP + NSGA-II/LNS
finding: Hybrid NSGA-II+LNS outperforms conventional evolutionary algorithms for sustainable locker location.

problem: VRP with drones, robot stations and time windows
method: MILP with valid inequalities + iterated local search metaheuristic
finding: 3P-GMS-ILS outperforms MILP and existing metaheuristics; combining trucks, drones and robots reduces costs.

problem: mobile warehouse location and two-echelon routing
finding: Mobile warehouses cut delivery distance but are economically viable mainly in high-density, clustered demand settings.

problem: multi-agent dynamic VRP
finding: Title only: decision-focused learning for distributionally robust multi-agent dynamic routing in e-commerce last-mile delivery.

problem: vehicle routing software selection
finding: An LP-based fuzzy MCDM method supports last-mile companies in selecting vehicle routing software.

problem: multi-period heterogeneous fleet VRP with self-pickup point selection
finding: Title only: studies multi-period heterogeneous fleet routing with self-pickup point selection in urban and rural last-mile delivery.

problem: mobile depot allocation and hybrid order dispatch with crowdshipping
finding: DRL jointly optimises mobile depot allocation and dispatch under crowd-shipper and customer behavioural uncertainty.

problem: periodic location-routing with collection-and-delivery points
finding: Benders-based heuristic effectively solves rural e-commerce location-routing with flexible service times and CDPs.

problem: last-mile delivery route optimisation for new users
finding: MILP+IGA reduced average delivery time by 15% and costs by 20% for new users.

problem: freight-on-transit assignment for last-mile delivery
finding: Heuristic minimises bus offloads and last-mile delivery time when integrating freight into a bus network.

problem: two-echelon load-dependent VRP with vans and delivery robots (e-grocery)
finding: Combining vans and robots in a two-echelon system lowers transport and emission costs for e-grocery delivery.

problem: VRP with load-dependent travel times for cargo bicycles
finding: Title only: studies vehicle routing with load-dependent travel times for cargo bikes.

problem: two-echelon VRP with mobile satellites and multiple commodities
finding: AS-LNS effectively solves the 3M-2E-VRP and sensitivity analysis yields insights on last-mile delivery strategies.

problem: stochastic dynamic order assignment and two-echelon dispatching
finding: Parameterised CFA and ALNS policies support real-time end-to-end e-commerce order assignment and dispatch.

problem: VRP with private and shared delivery locations
finding: Title only: studies routing where deliveries can go to private or shared delivery locations.

problem: VRPTW with delivery robots
finding: Title only: proposes an ALNS heuristic for vehicle routing with time windows and delivery robots.

problem: time-dependent EVRPTW
finding: Branch-cut-and-price framework handles time-dependent travel times and energy consumption for electric last-mile delivery.

problem: covering delivery problem with EV and parcel lockers
finding: Title only: applies VNS to a covering delivery problem with electric vehicles and parcel lockers.

problem: freight-on-transit with drone delivery
finding: Freight-on-transit with drones yields significant cost savings, with buffer capacity and battery life being key.

problem: same-day delivery with crowdshipping and store fulfilment
method: dynamic programming approximated by MILP, rolling horizon
finding: Rolling-horizon MILP assigns orders from local stores to crowdshippers to minimise immediate plus expected future cost.

problem: VRP with heterogeneous fixed drivers
finding: HAGA produces high-quality solutions that account for driver regional knowledge and qualifications.

problem: distribution network design with drop-and-swap terminals
finding: Location models with hours-of-service and drop-and-swap operations improve profitability by about 5% (2.3-11% in tests).

problem: pharmacy home medication delivery batching
finding: Optimal batching and delivery-mode choice increases the pharmacy's logistical financial outcome by 34%.

problem: multi-depot VRP with split deliveries and multiple trips
finding: List Scheduling + Transformer achieved lower route costs and more balanced travel times than classical heuristics.

problem: VRP with drones and en route operations
finding: Title only: proposes a hybrid VNS/tabu search for vehicle routing with drones and en route operations.
